description: This PHP source file defines the SystemConfiguration class which manages core system configurations for the OrangeHRM enterprise HR management system. It includes methods for retrieving organization details, localization settings, administrator info, and managing instance identifiers, as well as database interactions related to registration events.

classes.name: SystemConfiguration
classes.description: A class providing methods to access and manipulate system-level configurations, retrieve organization info, manage instance identifiers, and handle registration events in the OrangeHRM HR management system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SystemConfiguration object and its ConfigHelper dependency.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the Doctrine database connection instance.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Returns the schema manager for database schema operations.

methods.name: getOrganizationName
methods.description: Fetches the organization name from the database or returns 'Not Captured' if not available.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Fetches the organization country from the database or returns 'Not Captured' if not available.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the default language setting from configuration or defaults to 'en_US'.

methods.name: getAdminFirstName
methods.description: Gets the first name of the admin user; defaults to 'Admin'.

methods.name: getAdminLastName
methods.description: Gets the last name of the admin user.

methods.name: getAdminEmail
methods.description: Retrieves the email of the admin user.

methods.name: getAdminContactNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the contact number of the admin user.

methods.name: getAdminUserName
methods.description: Fetches the username associated with the admin employee.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the stored instance identifier if available.

methods.name: getAdminEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the admin employee number from the database.

methods.name: setInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Creates and stores a new instance identifier based on system info.

methods.name: createInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Generates a base64-encoded string that uniquely identifies this system instance.

methods.name: isRegistrationEventQueueAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the registration event queue table exists in the database.

methods.name: saveRegistrationEvent
methods.description: Inserts a registration event record into the event queue table.
